[Draft Mode](/docs/app/guides/draft-mode) bypasses the cache entirely (no read or write). ### `options.next.revalidate` ```ts fetch(`https://...`, { next: { revalidate: false | 0 | number } }) ``` Set the cache lifetime of a resource (in seconds). - **`false`** - Cache the resource indefinitely.
